label: CNC_Delta_NC510_CN01
info:
CNC path only (independent of Servo Press).

Edge LO device 10 (Delta NC510) → PMS machine 1 (CN01).
1) Every 1s: GET Edge tags → POST /api/machines/cnc-live {machine_id:1, tags:[...]}
2) On StatusCode change (or 30s heartbeat): PATCH /api/machines/1/status.

IMPORTANT: Restart PMS (uvicorn) after deploying this flow so /cnc-live exists.
A 404 {detail: Not Found} means the backend is still on the old code.

StatusCode map: 1=running 2=idle 3=alarm 4=offline.
If StatusCode sticks at 2 while ActSpindle/ActFeed is active, status is overridden to running.

name: cfg CNC target
map tags → CNC live (machine 1)
StatusCode → PATCH machine 1
